info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Payments-v5-spec
info.description: The List Education Enrollment Payments API enables users to retrieve comprehensive details about payments associated with education enrollments. This endpoint provides essential insights into financial transactions tied to enrollment statuses, helping educational institutions manage and track payments effectively. It is especially useful for administrators and finance departments monitoring payment processing and ensuring accuracy in financial reporting. Typical applications include generating reports, verifying payment statuses, and reconciling accounts.

get.description: Fetches the payment details associated with a specific enrollment, allowing users to access financial information relevant to their curriculum commitments.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve payment information related to enrollments. Ensure that you provide the necessary data structure as specified in the schema.

201.description: Payment successfully processed and enrollment created.
